title: LEAD ENGINEER - FIRMWARE
jobDescription: # Job Description: AUTOSAR Lead Engineer **Position Title: ** AUTOSAR LEAD ENGINEER / EMBEBEDDED LEAD ENGINEER (AUTOSAR) **Location: ** [Bangalore] **Employment Type: ** Full-Time **Experience Level: ** 6-10 years ## About the Role We are looking for an experienced AUTOSAR Lead Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and configure embedded software for Automotive Electronic Control Units (ECUs). You will work on production automotive programs, developing AUTOSAR-compliant software components, configuring Basic Software (BSW) modules, and integrating application software with the AUTOSAR stack. You will collaborate with system architects, hardware teams, and OEM/Tier-1 stakeholders to deliver safe, reliable, and standards-compliant automotive software. ## Key Responsibilities ### AUTOSAR Development & Configuration - Design and develop AUTOSAR Software Components (SWCs) — application layer development based on system requirements. - Configure and integrate AUTOSAR Basic Software (BSW) modules: COM stack (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet), Memory stack (NvM, Fee, Ea), Diagnostic stack (Dcm, Dem, FiM), Mode Management (BswM, EcuM, ComM), OS, and Watchdog. - Configure the RTE (Runtime Environment) and generate/integrate RTE code. - Work with AUTOSAR toolchains such as **Vector DaVinci Developer/Configurator, EB tresos, ETAS ISOLAR, or Mentor VSTAR**. - Create and maintain ARXML files, software component descriptions, and ECU extract integration. - Develop and integrate Complex Device Drivers (CDD) where standard modules are insufficient. ### Communication & Diagnostics - Implement and configure vehicle network communication: **CAN/CAN-FD, LIN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet (SOME/IP)**. - Configure and validate diagnostics per **UDS (ISO 14229) ** and OBD requirements; implement DTC handling, DIDs, and routines. - Support network management (NM) and communication matrix (DBC/LDF/ARXML) integration. ### Integration, Testing & Quality - Perform ECU software integration, build management, and MCAL integration with microcontroller platforms (e.g., Infineon Aurix, NXP, Renesas, TI). - Debug and analyze issues using tools such as **CANoe, CANalyzer, Lauterbach Trace32, or similar debuggers**. - Support unit testing, integration testing, and HIL validation activities. - Ensure compliance with **ISO 26262 (Functional Safety)** processes and support safety analyses (ASIL decomposition, safety mechanisms). - Follow **ASPICE**-compliant development processes; contribute to requirements traceability using tools like DOORS or Polarion. ## Required Skills & Qualifications - Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. - 6+ years of hands-on experience in **AUTOSAR Classic Platform** development and configuration. - Strong **Embedded C** programming skills for automotive microcontrollers. - Solid understanding of the **AUTOSAR layered architecture**: Application layer, RTE, BSW (Services, ECU Abstraction, MCAL). - Hands-on experience with at least one AUTOSAR toolchain: **Vector DaVinci, EB tresos, ETAS ISOLAR**, or equivalent. - Experience with automotive communication protocols: **CAN/CAN-FD, LIN**, and preferably FlexRay or Ethernet. - Working knowledge of **UDS diagnostics (ISO 14229) **. - Familiarity with debugging/measurement tools: **CANoe, CANalyzer, Trace32**. - Experience with version control (Git/SVN) and requirement management tools (DOORS, Polarion, Jira). - Understanding of the embedded software development lifecycle in an **ASPICE** environment. ## Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills - Experience with **AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform** (C++, SOME/IP, ara::com). - Knowledge of **ISO 26262** functional safety up to ASIL-D; experience implementing safety mechanisms (E2E protection, memory partitioning). - Exposure to **Cybersecurity (ISO 21434) **, SecOC, and secure boot/flash concepts. - Experience with **bootloader development** (Flash Bootloader, FOTA). - Scripting skills in **Python or CAPL** for test automation and tooling. - Experience with model-based development (MATLAB/Simulink, Embedded Coder, TargetLink). - Domain experience in powertrain, body electronics, ADAS, braking, or battery management systems (BMS). - Experience working directly with OEMs or Tier-1 suppliers. ## Soft Skills - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. - Clear written and verbal communication; ability to work with global, cross-functional teams and customer stakeholders. - Self-driven with the ability to own modules/features end to end. - Attention to detail and commitment to automotive quality and safety standards.

title: SENIOR ENGINEER - DATA ANALYTICS
jobDescription: Job Title: Data Engineer Job Summary We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data platforms that support enterprise analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives. The role involves developing ETL/ELT pipelines, integrating multiple data sources, and transforming raw data into high-quality, analytics-ready datasets. The Data Engineer will work closely with data architects, data engineering leads, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to build reliable, efficient, and secure data systems across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS environments. Key Responsibilities Data Pipeline Development • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar data integration platforms. • Build scalable data ingestion pipelines to collect structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from multiple enterprise sources. • Implement batch and streaming data pipelines to support analytics and reporting requirements. • Transform and process raw data into clean, structured, and analytics-ready datasets. Data Platform Development • Support the development and maintenance of data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouse architectures. • Implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) to organize and refine datasets for analytics consumption. • Develop data processing workflows using Python, PySpark, Spark, and SQL. • Work with distributed data processing frameworks to handle large-scale datasets efficiently. Data Quality and Reliability • Implement data validation, cleansing, and transformation logic within data pipelines. • Monitor data pipelines to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. • Troubleshoot pipeline failures and optimize workflows for performance. Collaboration and Delivery • Work with data architects and data engineering leads to implement scalable data architectures. • Collaborate with analytics teams and business stakeholders to understand data requirements. • Document data pipelines, data flows, and data models to ensure maintainability. • Follow best practices for data engineering, version control, and deployment automation. Required Skills and Experience • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL. • Experience working with data engineering tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms. • Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration workflows. • Familiarity with Spark, PySpark, or distributed data processing frameworks. • Understanding of data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouse architectures. • Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. • Understanding of data modeling and data transformation techniques. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Spark Streaming. • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, or Snowflake Snowpipe. • Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality frameworks. • Experience working in Agile development environments. • Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines or feature engineering workflows. Experience: 2-5 Years Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Location: Bangalore
